page.layout: One page of text. At the top, a running head centred and the page number at top right. Below the head, two round woodcut medallions side by side, with captions printed around their circles (left: PRIAMVS / TROLAN; right: ECV / HB). Below them, one column of running text in full width. At the foot, a gathering signature at the right of the last line.

main_text.l: PRIAMVS Laomedontis filius, interfecto patre ab Her-
cule, Troiaq; vi capta, regnum patris recepit, quod ei Hercules
tradidit vt viro iusto, amicoque. Solus enim filiorum patri con-
fuluerat equos diuino femine procreatos (si credere fas est) Her-
culi, ob liberatam Hesionem promissos, tradendos. Hæc Diod.
Sic. lib. 5. Sunt tamen qui scribant Priamū captiuum ab Hercu-
le abductum in Græciā, postea auro à vicinis re-demptum, vn-
de à redimendo nomen obtinuerit. Habuit filios quinquagin-
ta:vnde Vergi.

l.i: Quinquaginta illi thalami, spes tanta nepotum:

main_text.l: ex his decē & septē sustulit ex iusta vxore Hecuba: inter quos
insigniores fuere Hector, Paris, Deiphobus, Helenus, Polites,
Polydorus. Capta vrbe à Græcis, interemptus est Priamus se-
nex, à Pyrrho Achillis filio: ídque ad aram Iouis, in sanguine
etiam Politæ filij sui. autor Dictys Cretensis. Troiæ Priamus re-
gnat anno mundi 2725. ante Christum natum 1237. quam ita
ampliauit & ornauit vt nulli maximarum vrbium ornatu &
potentia cederet.
HECVBA Cissei regis Thracum filia, vxor Priami fuit.
Hæc cùm Paridem in vtero gestaret, somniauit se parere facem
ardentem, quæ patriam exureret. Hanc in canem versam fabu-
lantur, quòd cùm vrbe capta, captiua abduceretur, ac Polydori
filij corpus in mare proiectum agnosceret, Græcos inanibus la-
cessiuerit conuiciis. Vergil. Aen. 10. lib. Ouid. 13. Metamorpho.

page.notes: The two medallions are woodcut portraits with captions printed in their circles: left "PRIAMVS" and "TROLAN"; right "ECV" and a monogram "HB" (the second letter group is doubtful, [?]). A red ink spot below the left medallion is not print and is left out. Doubtful readings: "Vergi." at the end of the first paragraph may be cut off or abbreviated; "Hector" is set as printed with no accent visible in the scan. The woodcut captions are not transcribed as part of the running text.
